_source: DWD cap_warncellids.csv (DISTRICT level, WARNCELLID prefix 1) + the DWD POI observation feed (opendata.dwd.de/weather/weather_reports/poi/).
_note: Operational places for Mittelfranken (MASTER_PROMPT §10). warncell_ids = the DWD DISTRICT warncells covering the place (Stadt + Kreis). poi_station_id = the nearest DWD POI observation station; empty where DWD has none nearby (E18-04 then shows 'keine Daten'). A deployment may add places / override ids.
